name: DipBuyer AI
description: A value-investing agent whose verdicts come from deterministic, versioned rules rather than a language model. Every decision it makes is hashed into a Merkle batch and anchored on Monad, so any single verdict can be proved against the chain afterwards.

skills.name: Screen an equity
skills.description: Applies the versioned rule set to one company and returns a verdict with the criteria that produced it.

skills.name: Prove a past decision
skills.description: Returns the Merkle inclusion proof for a decision, verifiable against the anchored root on Monad without trusting this agent.
